generations.name: Eighth generation (battery-electric)
generations.notes: The new-generation ES is the first with battery-electric versions, ES 350e (FWD) and ES 500e (AWD): 74.7 kWh pack, NACS port. Only the electric ES is in our scope; the ES hybrid is not a BEV and the regulator imports are BEV-only, so the bare "ES" prefix is safe. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://pressroom.lexus.com/?p=75723 ; https://pressroom.lexus.com/2027-lexus-es-battery-electric-models-return-with-up-to-307-miles-of-epa-estimated-total-range/
